reuse.why: Extracts a new getRangeAmount and reuses it everywhere, but ignores the existing getScheduledAmount that already decides the missing/number/range dispatch the sites keep re-implementing.

duplication.why: The range arithmetic is now shared, but four sites keep their own `null ? 0 : number ? value : range` dispatch that duplicates getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The new rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the five ranged-amount sites, the shared helper, a test and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: The rule is in one function so future changes are easy, though two overlapping helpers and repeated per-site dispatch remain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and schedule-template.ts keep their own dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: the per-site number/range dispatch is left verbatim, not reshaped; only the arithmetic was extracted

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, called by getScheduledAmount and by all five server sites
